items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: I find some of Ornette’s — you know some of his heavier stuff, I still find it really memorable.

ctx.x: But anyhow, you know everybody is different, so for me I like things that are singable, even if they’re really difficult and whacky sounding. I mean I find some of Ornette’s — you know some of his heavier stuff, I still find it really memorable.
Do you and Larry comment on each other’s music and composing and so forth.
